surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012240149 ring (PDOK BAG, CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/akzonobel-center-footprints.json, modern-prepare.mjs). The split between the taller west wedge and the lower east volume follows the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof planes (45.2 and 41.8-42.7 m NAP, AHN4); the leaning glass between them from the PDOK orthophoto and the photographs; fronts, plinth and lettering from the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas and Wikimedia Commons photographs (scripts/landmarks/akzonobel-center-inventory.json). The shared parking garage pand 0363100012240015 (Christian Neefestraat 50, underground) is not part of this model.
